blockers.reason: No qualified independent task: candidate history independence unsigned; event precedes prospective protocol; prepared sources alone do not certify independence.
All six references have null reviewer/decision; no independent accepted reference or executable scoring mapping.
No two-model measured profiles matching terms/observed/reconcile contracts; separate calibration task identities absent.
Production same-state fork, authoritative frozen policy binding and full-terminal independent scoring not bound. Offline adapter has no live backend; joint executor returns truncated report summary.
Actual account region, model access/version stability, complete tokenized prompts and applicable billing not certified; operational cash limits cannot be finalized.
One event/two repeats cannot establish cross-event reproducible or confirmatory benefit. No natural feedback observed; absence must be retained, not repaired with synthetic faults.

policy.freeze_scope: comparison semantics only; no certified deployed policy
policy.initial: shared resource-constrained initial allocation from identical calibration data
policy.Static-Pi: retain initial pi for all remaining nodes; same legal repair/cache reuse
policy.Dynamic-Pi: recompare all remaining pi after same feedback; retention is eligible
policy.R: identical dependency-legal necessary repair; NOT TESTED
policy.code_objective: predicted makespan then CNY then USD then model ID
policy.code_feedback: latest observed elapsed/model predicted latency ratio
policy.fairness_gap: existing fixed-policy feasibility uses empty scale, dynamic uses updated scale: not certified same-constraint experiment
policy.quality: UNKNOWN remains null; no invented lower bounds

paired.trigger: first natural model contract failure with remaining work; wait for in-flight results before snapshot; no injected faults
paired.no_trigger: retain as no-feedback event; shared unchanged result labelled shared, not independent observations
paired.snapshot: same graph, evidence, parent-output fingerprints, legal cache, feedback, remaining resources and model slots
paired.same_action: report zero action difference; no claim from arm names
paired.recovery: one continuation attempt per legally required pending node, no further retry or replan; common R
paired.wall_clock: fresh identical residual deadline per continuation; charge detection/planning/execution, exclude waiting for other arm from its own time; report whole experiment elapsed separately

budget.deadline_rule_proposed: per event total deadline = 1.5 * calibrated predicted initial makespan; frozen before test responses; no reliability guarantee
budget.condition: non-thinking, actual serialized input<=16384, billed output<=3072, model/region/rates unchanged; each model 6 calibration + at most18 evaluation calls; currency extrema not simultaneously attainable

scoring.Q: six fact correctness statuses separately, UNKNOWN not zero or one
scoring.E: real versioned source and sufficient support, not quote matching alone
scoring.proposed_primary: all six required deliverables valid under approved Q/E/K, within deadline; no artifact/refusal/failed dependency = unsuccessful task, Q unknown retained
scoring.unscorable_reference: blocks independent quality conclusion; cannot infer success
scoring.extra_claims: unsupported or false material additions fail proposed terminal-success criterion
scoring.denominator: all enrolled event-repetitions, including refusals/failures/no-trigger; not-started due batch stop separately retained; system failure batch INCOMPLETE

analysis.full_cost: shared prefix/calibration physically counted once; equal allocation per deployed-policy comparison; report marginal and full costs; unsettled costs UNKNOWN
analysis.inference: descriptive only for n=1 event; no p-value, population CI, equivalence or reliability .95 claim
analysis.robustness: unresolved outcome item bounds, not imputed quality; cannot fix unresolved reference by sensitivity alone
analysis.benefit: report observed dominance/tradeoff only; no predeclared universal gain or posthoc weighting

stop_rules: no paid calls without separate batch authorization
atomic global/per-model/per-arm request and native-currency reservation before dispatch
unmetered response/transport or evaluator exception stops batch; keep pending reservations
normal model failure retained, illegal output blocks dependents; no automatic batch abort solely for model error
